prose.text: The gates below run in /implement P2 on the merged, uncommitted tree and again in the wrap's light gate on the committed merge. Their git bases are the chunk start commit `a703136` or the two fixed upstream shas, so they read the same after the operator's pre-CI commit.

- **Merge witness and guards** — the witness is green when the pin is `MERGE_HEAD` (before the operator's commit) or an ancestor of HEAD (after it). The probes after it read: no conflict marker left; our root-manifest lines kept; upstream's pin set taken, with no git Taffy left; the lock resolving as committed, our two entries at beta.3 and its third-party set equal to upstream's; the fork's own scripts, workflows, stand, driver, telemetry, harness and inherited-engine surfaces untouched; every merge surface of ours read present after the merge (changed-set marks, the mask's two functions, the two readers, both bodies of the bounds reader, `hit_inner`, the tree override and `bridge_tests`, the shell's refresh); the conflict resolutions in place; and a fixed-sha census of upstream's delta. - **The `test = false` reading is three entries**, as at the last sync: the workspace build set lists no `tests/all.rs` executable, the workspace test log runs none, and the a11y leg's log runs none. - **By-name presence** — one entry walks `tests/blitz-tests/tests/*.rs` and counts the files, `all.rs` aside, whose `Running tests/{name}.rs` line is absent from the workspace test log; upstream's five new files are among those it reads. A second entry reads the five by name. - **Both builds** — `ci-leg.sh fast` runs the workspace build (blitz-dom's `tracing` and `writing-mode` compiled in); `agent-run.sh run stand` and `run all` run `-p blitz-tests`; `cargo test -p seven_guis` runs the two sink-installing hosts' needle checks (`host_log`, `mcp_log`) in the per-package build (test-plan §9 Engine features by runner; obs-plan §8). - **Counts** — the workspace tally is asserted on `failed 0` and recorded against the prediction in step 11; the CI-scripts tally is report-only because its number is a forecast (78 today; predicted 79 — upstream's one added test in `test_wpt_area_changes.py`); the a11y leg's 3 result lines and 15 passed are asserted, since the merge changes none of its three files. - **Not run locally:** `msrv` (`cargo +1.91`) and the wasm leg — no 1.91 toolchain or wasm32 target on this host, and `taffy 0.15.0` is not in the local registry, so its MSRV is the CI job's reading — and the windows, macos, ios and android legs. The operator entries push the merge and read the run that covers them; the last entry reads that our checks ran in the macOS and Windows jobs. - **Windowed boot smoke** — listed because the merge changes layout and UA styling under `seven_guis_native`. It declares `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`, turns `timeout`'s 124 into its own exit 0 (`.claude/rules/verification-harness.md` Session Additions 2026-10-06) and reads `not run — env unset` without a display. - **No mutation entry** — the mutation tier stays unstarted on the founder's word (inputs#I2); no entry runs mutants. - **No live leg**: nothing here drives a process the launch environment names. **The evidence records have no listed producer, by construction**: the six records of step 11 are /implement's and the operator pass's hand records of what the entries read, and `counts.md`'s pre-merge half is step 1's one-shot reading on `a703136`, which no entry can re-run on the merged tree. No entry carries one of them as `artifact`.
